One summer, single men and women—David and Barbara, Daniel and Daphné, Clément and Vilma, Lassana and Marine, Geoffroy and Anna, James and Florence, Yves and Marie-Claire, Thomas and Inès, Simon and Elora, Patrice and Corinne—meet for the first time over a drink in Parisian cafés.
